model.memory: FIFO retained outcome bits; Python objects, replay metadata and evaluator storage excluded
model.noise: one independent Bernoulli(noise_p) Pauli-Z per fresh qubit
model.precision_resolved: Wilson expectation interval half-width <= declared tolerance
model.scope: restricted statistical observer model; no calibration of ORT presence or physical collapse
